description: Checkbox extends the native HTMLInputElement checkbox properties and renders the input inside a label container.

elements.name: label
elements.description: The accessible label text for the checkbox.

elements.name: checked
elements.description: Controls the checked state. Use with onChange or onValue for a controlled checkbox.

elements.name: defaultChecked
elements.description: Sets the initial checked state for an uncontrolled checkbox.

elements.name: onValue
elements.description: Called with the next checked state when the checkbox changes.

elements.name: indeterminate
elements.description: Displays the native indeterminate state, commonly used when only some items in a group are selected.

elements.name: position
elements.description: Places the checkmark on the left (default) or right of the label.

elements.name: size
elements.description: Sets the checkbox size. Available values are sm, md, and lg.

elements.name: required
elements.description: Marks the native checkbox as required.

elements.name: disabled
elements.description: Disables the native checkbox and prevents interaction.

elements.name: hideLabel
elements.description: Hides the visible label while keeping it as the input's accessible name.

elements.name: tooltip
elements.description: Adds tooltip content and associates it with the input through aria-describedby.

elements.name: checkmark
elements.description: Replaces the default checkmark with a React node or a function receiving checked and indeterminate.

elements.name: containerProps
elements.description: Passes native label attributes and handlers to the outer container.

accessibility.general: The component uses a native input type="checkbox" inside a label, preserving native keyboard, form, checked, required, disabled, and indeterminate semantics.
elements: Always provide a meaningful label. When hideLabel is enabled, the label is exposed through aria-label.
Tooltip content is connected to the input with aria-describedby; use it as supplemental guidance rather than the only accessible name.
The visual checkmark is marked aria-hidden="true"; the native input remains the source of the checkbox state.
